title: Diverse Community Data for Benchmarking Data Privacy Algorithms
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. It focused on the utility and privacy of deidentified demographic data, with a specific focus on equitable performance across subgroups defined by race, sex, and geography.
findings: The paper does not contain any analysis or findings related to religion. The study's focus is on data deidentification techniques and their impact on diverse subpopulations defined by race, sex, and geography, using US Census data excerpts that do not include religious affiliation as a feature.
